zh-CN.title: 手绘小屋成为真正的多图层世界
items: 夜航友间与午后花房重制为环境、角色、前后景植物与动作效果多图层
每只动物按自身习性行动，植物从根部摆动，并彻底移除成品图裁切动画

en.title: The illustrated rooms become truly layered worlds
items: Rooms at Night and Afternoon Conservatory now use environment, character, vegetation, and action-effect layers
Every animal follows its own habits, plants move from rooted anchors, and finished-art cutout animation is gone
